patches.updated_disclaimer: Counts of GNIS features whose names include 'Sound' by state, covering marine straits between islands and mainland as well as broad estuarine passages. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).
Average April 1 snow water equivalent across all SNOTEL sites in each state. April 1 is the traditional peak for the Western U.S. snowpack cycle. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).
Count of DSP-licensed craft distilleries operating in each state (ACSA definition). Includes Washington DC.
Bonded winery count includes all TTB-permitted winery premises, from major producers to boutique operations. DC not included (source omits it).
Total count of currently listed farmers markets in the USDA Local Food Portal directory. Includes Washington DC.
Battery-electric vehicles as share of new light-duty registrations; hybrids and plug-in hybrids excluded. Includes Washington DC.
Cumulative installed onshore + offshore wind nameplate capacity in gigawatts. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).
Average residential retail price of electricity in cents per kilowatt-hour, all sectors annualized. Includes Washington DC.
Total count includes standard, PO Box, unique (single-recipient) and military ZIP codes. Includes Washington DC.
Count of active licensed drivers (all classes) by state of residence, in millions. Includes Washington DC.
Deaths from all firearm-related injuries (suicide, homicide, accidental) per 100,000 residents, age-adjusted. Includes Washington DC.
Cumulative all-time count of species accepted on official state checklists. Includes Washington DC.
Total federal trust and reservation acreage held for tribes and individuals; excludes Alaska Native Corporation lands (ANCSA) which have a different legal status. Includes Washington DC.
Number of initial + continuing H-1B approvals for beneficiaries whose worksite is located in each state. Includes Washington DC.
Total known playable courts including dedicated pickleball courts and tennis/multi-use courts lined for pickleball. Includes Washington DC.
Driving-under-the-influence arrests per 100,000 residents. Rates reflect enforcement intensity and legal thresholds as much as underlying impaired-driving prevalence. Includes Washington DC.
Counts operating commercial reactors licensed by the NRC; excludes research reactors and units in decommissioning. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).
Share of total electricity generated within the state that comes from coal-fired power plants; excludes imported power. Includes Washington DC.
Share of in-state electricity generation from natural gas; excludes imports and behind-the-meter generation. Includes Washington DC.
Conventional hydroelectric only; excludes pumped-storage hydro (which is net-consumer of electricity). DC not included (topic is state-scoped).
